name: Saudi Arabia Mobile Number (KSA)
description: Matches Saudi Arabia mobile numbers in international (+966) or local (05x) format across STC, Mobily, and Zain networks.

name: UAE Mobile Number (e& / du)
description: Matches United Arab Emirates mobile phone numbers in international (+971) or local (05x) format.

name: Qatar Mobile Number (Ooredoo / Vodafone)
description: Matches Qatar 8-digit mobile phone numbers starting with prefixes 3, 5, 6, 7 with optional +974 country code.

name: Kuwait Mobile Number (Zain / Ooredoo / STC)
description: Matches Kuwait 8-digit mobile numbers starting with prefixes 5, 6, 9 with optional +965 country code.

name: Oman Mobile Number (Omantel / Ooredoo / Vodafone)
description: Matches Sultanate of Oman 8-digit mobile numbers starting with prefixes 7 or 9 with optional +968 country code.

name: Bahrain Mobile Number (Batelco / Zain / STC)
description: Matches Kingdom of Bahrain 8-digit mobile numbers starting with prefixes 3 or 6 with optional +973 country code.

name: GCC Mobile Phone Number (Unified 6 Nations)
description: Unified detector capturing mobile numbers across all 6 GCC states (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Bahrain).

name: Java Stack Trace Line / Call Site
description: Matches Java stack trace execution frames indicating package hierarchy, class, method, and source line numbers (including Java 9+ module prefixes).

name: Java Exception Declaration & Root Cause
description: Matches Java runtime exceptions, standard errors, and 'Caused by:' exception chain declarations in logs.
examples: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke String.length() because str is null

name: Java Framework Stack Frame (Spring / Hibernate / Tomcat)
description: Matches framework-specific internal traces (Spring Boot, Hibernate ORM, Apache Tomcat Catalina, HikariCP).

name: JVM OutOfMemoryError Alert
description: Detects Java Virtual Machine OutOfMemoryError notifications (Heap Space, Metaspace, GC Overhead Limit).
pattern: \bjava\.lang\.OutOfMemoryError:\s+(?:Java heap space|Metaspace|GC overhead limit exceeded|Direct buffer memory|Requested array size exceeds VM limit)\b

name: Java JDBC SQL Exception / Query Leak
description: Detects database query errors, syntax exceptions, and internal table structure leakage in Java SQL stack traces.
examples: java.sql.SQLException: Access denied for user 'app_user'@'10.0.1.4' (using password: YES)
org.hibernate.exception.SQLGrammarException: could not prepare statement [SELECT * FROM users WHERE ssn = ?]
org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: ERROR: relation "accounts_internal" does not exist

name: Java JVM Thread Dump Header
description: Matches JVM thread dump diagnostic declarations containing thread IDs, states, and native thread pointers.
examples: "http-nio-8080-exec-1" #24 daemon prio=5 os_prio=0 cpu=120.45ms elapsed=42.10s tid=0x00007f9c8401a000 nid=0x1a2b

name: Angular Error Code (NG0xxx)
description: Matches Angular runtime error diagnostic codes and descriptions (e.g. NG0100, NG0200, NG0201).
examples: NG0100: ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenCheckedError: Expression has changed after it was checked.
NG0200: Circular dependency in DI detected for ServiceA -> ServiceB -> ServiceA.
NG0201: No provider for HttpClient found in R3Injector.

name: Angular NullInjectorError / Missing Provider
description: Matches Angular dependency injection failures, R3Injector traces, and missing token errors in console logs.
examples: NullInjectorError: R3InjectorError(AppModule)[AuthService -> HttpClient]: No provider for HttpClient!
NullInjectorError: R3InjectorError(UserModule)[UserService -> ConfigToken]: No provider for ConfigToken

name: Angular ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenCheckedError
description: Detects Angular change detection cycle discrepancies reporting previous vs current evaluated states.
examples: ExpressionChangedAfterItHasBeenCheckedError: Previous value: 'false'. Current value: 'true'. Expression has changed

name: Angular Zone.js Stack Trace Dump
description: Matches internal Angular Zone.js asynchronous task tracking frames that clutter frontend console logs.

name: Angular Webpack / Bundle Source Path Reference
description: Matches Angular Webpack internal module paths and source map references exposing client directory layout.

name: Angular Template Compiler / Parse Error
description: Detects Angular Ahead-of-Time (AOT) and Just-in-Time (JIT) template compilation and element binding errors.
pattern: \bTemplate parse errors:\s*Can't bind to '[^']+' since it isn't a known property of '[^']+'
examples: Template parse errors: Can't bind to 'ngModel' since it isn't a known property of 'input'.
Template parse errors: Can't bind to 'userPermissions' since it isn't a known property of 'app-admin-panel'.

name: Localhost & Local Loopback Dev URL
description: Matches developer workstation URLs pointing to localhost or 127.0.0.1 with local development port numbers.

name: Internal RFC 1918 Private IP with Port
description: Matches private RFC 1918 IPv4 addresses (10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x) with optional service ports.

name: Internal Corporate & Dev Hostname / FQDN
description: Matches internal network domain suffixes commonly used in corporate dev/staging environments (.corp, .internal, .local, .lan).

name: Git Remote URL with Embedded Credentials / PAT
description: Matches Git clone/remote URLs containing embedded usernames, personal access tokens (PAT), or passwords.

name: Git Commit SHA Hash (SHA-1 / SHA-256)
description: Matches 40-character SHA-1 or 64-character SHA-256 commit hashes and release shas in build and deployment logs.

name: Developer Local Filesystem Absolute Path
description: Matches developer home directories and project paths across Linux, macOS, and Windows workstation environments.

name: Database Connection URI with Credentials
description: Matches database connection strings with embedded credentials (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, JDBC).

name: HTTP Authorization Header Secret
description: Matches Bearer and Basic authentication headers in cURL requests, API logs, and HTTP request headers.

name: Package Manager Registry Auth Token (.npmrc / Maven)
description: Matches NPM registry auth tokens (//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=npm_xxx), PyPI tokens, and Maven credentials.

name: Environment Variable Secret Assignment (.env / logs)
description: Matches environment variable secret assignments (KEY=value, SECRET=value, PASSWORD=value) in terminal outputs and configs.

name: JSON Web Token (JWT)
description: Matches standard three-part base64url encoded JSON Web Tokens (JWT) used for session and API authorization.
